title: Zesty Turkish Eggplant Icli Kofte
description: A rich, juicy, and light Turkish dish featuring eggplant, perfect for a weeknight meal that's both Ayurvedic and Rajasic friendly.

ingredients.name: ground lamb
ingredients.notes: Use lean lamb for a healthier option.

ingredients.name: paprika
ingredients.notes: Smoked paprika adds a nice smokiness to the dish.

ingredients.name: cumin
ingredients.notes: Ground cumin adds warmth and depth to the dish.

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced eggplant and cook until it starts to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced red bell pepper and cook until the eggplant is tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and stir to combine.
Add the ground lamb and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it's no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice, smoked paprika, ground cumin, and a pinch of cayenne pepper.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the eggplant mixture hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
